clips.title: The story
paras: Silverwing Outpost is a fortified night elf garrison positioned in south-central Ashenvale, east of the Falfarren River. Commanded by Duriel Moonfire, it stands as the easternmost bastion of the Alliance against the Horde in the contested woodland.

Situated southwest of Splintertree Post and just north of the border with the Barrens, Silverwing Outpost holds an inherently perilous strategic position. By sitting on the eastern side of the Falfarren River—territory heavily contested and patrolled by the Horde—the outpost serves as a direct shield for night elf holdings deeper in the forest. Duriel Moonfire and her Silverwing Sentinels remain under constant siege from nearby orcs determined to purge night elf forces from the area entirely.
